source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Δημητρίων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the whole of its text is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Δημητρίων μαρτύρησε αφού θανατώθηκε με βέλη.» **The name is Δημητρίων and not Δημήτριος**, and it is left in that form: the page prints the name-meaning entry for Δημήτριος beneath it, which is the site's habit of glossing the nearest common name and not a statement that the two are one. None of the twenty-odd Demetrii and Demetriani the corpus keeps stands on this day or is killed by arrows. No year, no place, no emperor, no relics, no hymn.
